blocks.heading: Average Package Offered to NLU Graduates

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: The average package offered to NLU graduates in India runs roughly Rs 15-20 LPA, but this is pulled up hard by the top 5 NLUs. Graduates from tier-2 and tier-3 law colleges commonly start closer to Rs 3.6-4.8 LPA (about Rs 30,000-40,000 a month).

figures.source: Entry-level consultants at McKinsey, BCG, and Bain-tier firms in India typically start around Rs 16-24 LPA, with bonuses adding 20-40% on top. Government-focused advisory firms and pure policy think tanks pay considerably less at entry, commonly Rs 5-9 LPA for a policy analyst role.
